question: On a certain day in a certain place, the highest temperature was 3 ℃ and the lowest temperature was -9 ℃. What was the temperature difference that day, in ℃?
solution: Temperature difference = highest temperature − lowest temperature \(=3-(-9)=3+9=12\) (℃).
